hints.title: Digit Replacement Strategy
hints.text: To produce the maximum number, find the first digit that differs from 9 and remap all of its occurrences to 9.

hints.title: Minimization Strategy
hints.text: To produce the minimum number, remap all occurrences of the leading digit to 0.

hints.title: Difference Calculation
hints.text: Parse both modified representations as integers and compute the difference.

hints.title: Greedy Digit Remap Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minMaxDifference(self, num: int) -> int:
        s = str(num)
        max_d = None
        for ch in s:
            if ch != '9':
                max_d = ch
                break
        max_val = int(s.replace(max_d, '9')) if max_d else num
        min_d = s[0]
        min_val = int(s.replace(min_d, '0'))
        return max_val - min_val
```

variables: d: number of digits in num
complexity.notes: Linear scan across the digit string representation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 10x10 digit pairs is acceptable but slower than the direct greedy selection.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that greedy choice for max replaces the first non-9 and for min replaces the leading digit.
